Import.Title: Import from Long Story Short
Import.NoFiles: Choose .json files exported from Long Story Short.
Import.NoCharacters: The selected files contain no characters.
Import.EditionMismatch: The character's edition ({character}) does not match the world rules ({world}). The import can continue, but numbers and items may differ.
Import.BusyClose: The import is still running. Wait for it to finish.
Import.ActorNotFound: Actor not found: it may have been deleted.

Files.Label: Character and Grimoire files (.json)
Files.Hint: You can select several files. The files are read in the browser and are not sent anywhere.

ActorFolder.Name: Actors folder
ActorFolder.Hint: World folder for imported characters. Leave empty for the root.

SpellFolder.Name: Custom spells folder
SpellFolder.Hint: World folder for spells from the Grimoire. Each such spell is created once, and characters get copies of it.

ClassFeatures.Name: Class and race features
ClassFeatures.Hint: Add class, subclass, race and background features available at the character's current level.

UseAvatar.Name: Avatar from LSS
UseAvatar.Hint: Use the portrait from the LSS file as the actor image and token texture.

ExtraSpellPacks.Name: Extra spell compendiums
ExtraSpellPacks.Hint: Compendium IDs separated by commas, for example world.my-spells. They are searched before the standard dnd5e compendiums.
